_note: Free-text job discovery via signals-search textSearch. Used when the caller NAMES what they want (a role, a trade, an interest) or when they have no profile to anchor on. Same endpoint/auth as get_recommended_jobs. Verified 2026-09-23: 'data entry operator' returns scored Data Entry Operator postings with jobProviderName. jobProviderLocation is masked on this instance.
name: get_jobs
description: Find jobs by what the caller said they want. Pass their role or interest as English words (e.g. "data entry operator", "electrician", "security guard", "tailoring") - translate what they said in Hindi into English before sending, and send the WORK they want, not a place. Use this when the caller names a role, asks for something different from what their profile says, or has no profile. For a caller with a profile who has not named a role, use get_recommended_jobs instead. Returns message.items[]: item_id (the job_id to apply with), score, and item_state with role, jobProviderName (the company), positions, salaryMin/salaryMax when present. jobProviderLocation is masked on this instance - never speak it. An empty items[] means we genuinely have nothing in that role: say so plainly and never invent one.

query.description: The role or kind of work the caller wants, in ENGLISH words. Translate their Hindi into English first ("डेटा एंट्री" -> "data entry operator", "बिजली का काम" -> "electrician"). Words only - no place names, no salary, no punctuation.
